name: UnderlinePanels
description: `UnderlinePanels` is a tab-and-panel composition with an underlined tab list.

props.name: activationMode
props.description:
Whether arrow-key focus also selects a tab. `automatic` selects the focused tab; `manual` only moves focus,
and Enter, Space, or a click commits the selection. An explicit `TabList` `activateOnFocus` takes precedence.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Value of the tab selected on first render when uncontrolled.

props.name: loadingCounters
props.description: Shows placeholders in place of tab counters while their values load.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the newly selected tab's `value` when a user selects a different tab. Automatic fallbacks,
such as a missing or disabled selection, and re-selecting the current tab do not call it.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the selected tab when controlled. Update it from `onChange` or `onValueChange`.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Styles the outer layout and bottom-border wrapper without changing the tablist's className or ref.

props.name: counter
props.description: Number shown after the tab's label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component shown before the tab's label.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Visual shown before the tab's label, as an alternative to `icon`.
